Hi Lara & Samir —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum:

- Goal: run a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive focused on SSO, data isolation, and inference SLA expectations.
- Participants we think are helpful: Platform lead + Security (for SOC2 discussion) + Procurement for initial timeline.
- Proposed owners: Clearwater to own attendee list; Redwood to own agenda and demo environment.

3 proposed slots (PST):
- Tue, Mar 7 | 09:00–10:30
- Wed, Mar 8 | 13:00–14:30
- Thu, Mar 9 | 11:00–12:30

Can you confirm which of these works or share two alternatives? I’ll lock the calendar and loop in our SRE lead (Karthik) and Security PM (Marissa).

Thanks,
